route_guardian_loader.label: PMP Current Route Guardian Loader v14

current_app.label: PMP Current v16 clean ownership reset from v13

user_facing_rule: Only show PMP Current / PMP-CURRENT-1 as the app version.
home_screen_rule: Install pmp-app-current.html once. It is a stable map-driven door and should change as little as possible.
update_rule: Current v16 uses the ledger-identified last clean route family, pmp-current-inner-cleanbug-rgcontrols-v13.html#control, as the recovery baseline. It performs a hard ownership reset: current loads one Route Guardian Last Good owner only, pmp-route-guardian-last-good-clean-v1.js. It does not load pmp-last-good-label-v11.js, Recovery Tools v9, Move Ledger target-opening helpers, candidate panel helpers, stage/test helpers, or self-contained helper experiments. Route Guardian Last Good now has only Save Current, Copy Recovery Report, Saved Spots, and Back to Control. Recovery Tools v8 remains emergency-only. Packet 1.5, free-only gates, Safe Writer, Dashboard, and the core app shell are unchanged.
